scope: Expose the complete explicit HostNull matrix as a bounded focused producer without changing the low-cost recurring audit. Reuse four established workflow groups to emit seven independently checked artifacts across seventeen profiles, two author routes and five runtime positions. Reconcile all 170 exact package-receipt-bound cells into one same-run fail-closed receipt, preserve partial diagnostics without accepting them, and make no support promotion before hosted evidence is retained and independently replayed.

host_null:

- name: Qualify HostNull in prepared .NET packages
        id: host_null
        if: inputs.host_null

        timeout-minutes: 125
        run: bash scripts/run-host-null-managed-ci.sh dotnet

          overwrite: true

      - name: Enforce HostNull .NET support
        if: always() && inputs.host_null && steps.host_null.outcome != 'success'
        run: exit 1

          source scripts/env.sh
          export LEAN_BRIDGE_CORPUS_PERL="$PWD/.toolchains/perl/5.38.2-threaded/bin/perl"
          test -x "$LEAN_BRIDGE_CORPUS_PERL"

      - name: Preserve HostNull scripting acceptance

      - name: Enforce scripting HostNull support

host_null:
        description: Run complete explicit HostNull package acceptance.
        required: false
        type: boolean
        default: false

- name: Require explicit HostNull in Node, TypeScript and three browsers
        id: host_null
        if: inputs.host_null && matrix.route == 'reviewed'
        continue-on-error: true
        timeout-minutes: 120
        env:
          LEAN_BRIDGE_TYPE_CORPUS_BROWSERS: chromium,firefox,webkit
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          source scripts/env.sh
          node --test --test-concurrency=1 tests/host-null-npm-installed.test.mjs
          test -s build/host-null/npm/report.json
      - name: Preserve explicit HostNull npm and browser observations
        if: always() && inputs.host_null && matrix.route == 'reviewed'
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        with:
          name: host-null-node-browser-${{ github.sha }}
          path: build/host-null/npm/
          if-no-files-found: error
          overwrite: true
          retention-days: 30
      - name: Enforce explicit HostNull npm and browser acceptance
        if: always() && inputs.host_null && matrix.route == 'reviewed' && steps.host_null.outcome != 'success'
        run: exit 1

inputs:
      suite:
        description: Bounded explicit HostNull suite to execute
        required: true
        default: audit
        type: choice
        options:
          - audit
          - produce
if: inputs.suite != 'produce'

npm-browser:
    name: Node and browser producer
    if: inputs.suite == 'produce'
    uses: ./.github/workflows/generic-subtype-npm-browser.yml
    with:
      host_null: true

  native-perl:
    name: Scripting producer
    if: inputs.suite == 'produce'
    uses: ./.github/workflows/generic-subtype-native-perl.yml
    with:
      host_null: true

  managed-wit:
    name: Managed and systems producers
    if: inputs.suite == 'produce'
    uses: ./.github/workflows/generic-subtype-managed-wit.yml
    with:
      host_null: true

  php:
    name: PHP and PHP-Wasm producer
    if: inputs.suite == 'produce'
    uses: ./.github/workflows/nominal-subtype-php-wasm.yml
    with:
      host_null: true

  receipt:
    name: Reconcile the exact same-run receipt
    if: always() && inputs.suite == 'produce'
    needs:
      - npm-browser
      - native-perl
      - managed-wit
      - php
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 30
    steps:
      - name: Check out the exact producer revision
        uses: actions/checkout@v6
        with:
          fetch-depth: 1
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Install Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v6
        with:
          node-version: "22"
      - name: Download every same-run HostNull artifact
        id: download
        continue-on-error: true
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v5
        with:
          pattern: host-null-*-${{ github.sha }}
          path: build/host-null-complete-matrix-input
      - name: Reconcile all seventeen profiles, both author routes and five positions
        id: reconciliation
        if: always()
        continue-on-error: true
        run: |
          node scripts/reconcile-host-null-complete-matrix.mjs \
            --directory build/host-null-complete-matrix-input \
            --output build/host-null-complete-matrix/receipt.json \
            --producer "${{ github.sha }}" \
            --repository "${{ github.repository }}" \
            --workflow ".github/workflows/host-null-complete.yml" \
            --run-id "${{ github.run_id }}" \
            --run-attempt "${{ github.run_attempt }}"
      - name: Preserve the complete HostNull receipt
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        with:
          name: host-null-complete-matrix-${{ github.sha }}
          path: build/host-null-complete-matrix/receipt.json
          if-no-files-found: error
          overwrite: true
          retention-days: 30
      - name: Enforce every producer and exact receipt reconciliation
        if: >-
          always() &&
          (needs.npm-browser.result != 'success' ||
           needs.native-perl.result != 'success' ||
           needs.managed-wit.result != 'success' ||
           needs.php.result != 'success' ||
           steps.download.outcome != 'success' ||
           steps.reconciliation.outcome != 'success')
        run: exit 1
